components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A square black-ink action with paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; gap: 13px; border: 2px solid #111; padding: 13px 17px; background: #111; color: #f7f7f5; font: 500 11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), background-color .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d8d8d3; color: #111; transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A transparent ruled action for secondary paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; gap: 13px; border: 2px solid #111; padding: 13px 17px; background: transparent; color: #111; font: 500 11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform .18s ease, background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #111; color: #f7f7f5; transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: A square ruled case-study container with ambient hover lift.
components.html:
01 / CASE STUDY

Jukskani

Products built from the result backward.
components.css: .ds-project-card { min-height: 340px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; border: 2px solid #111; padding: 25px; background: #f7f7f5; color: #111; box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.12); } .ds-project-card span { font: 500 11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: #5c5c58; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-project-card h2 { margin: 35px 0 12px; font: 900 clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem)/.88 'Archivo', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.08em; } .ds-project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A centered mono index with a persistent theme control.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 2px solid #111; padding: 22px; font: 500 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hero Shader
components.description: A low-contrast black-and-white dithering field that adds a living paper texture behind the hero statement.
components.css: .ds-hero-shader { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: .14; background: #f7f7f5; pointer-events: none; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio behaves like a precise studio proof: white paper carries the reading experience, black ink establishes hierarchy, and rules mark the edges between ideas. Large typographic statements create the first impression while compact mono labels create an index that can be scanned quickly.

rules.name: The Ink-First Rule
rules.body: Color never competes with the work; hierarchy comes from contrast, scale, and spacing.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Display type makes the claim; mono type tells visitors where they are.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces stay quiet; depth only acknowledges a relationship or interaction.

dos: Do use grayscale as the complete visual palette.
Do let bold Archivo headlines carry hierarchy.
Do keep projects and contact visible in the main reading path.
donts: Don't reintroduce saturated accent colors or gradients.
Don't use rounded cards or pill-heavy controls.
